title: Crypto for Advisors: Wall Street is done waiting on Congress for crypto rules
How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
summary: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

title: Under pressure, Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
summary: Ledger’s Atom will run apps like WhatsApp and Instragram and let users switch between smartphone functions and a protected mode for managing digital assets.

title: Bitcoin, copper, stocks, yields all fall; gold rises
Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
summary: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.
